name: PDFtoMarkdown.ai
description: Converts local PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PNG/JPG, HTML and EPUB files into structured Markdown with headings, tables and OCR text, via the PDFtoMarkdown.ai API. API key required; free account includes 10 pages, then pay-per-page credits. Install: `npm install -g @happywp/pdftomarkdown-mcp` · [Docs](https://pdftomarkdown.ai/developers)
